targets.originalQuestion: 2017 年和 2018 年各有多少笔订单？
targets.originalGoldSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

targets.originalQuestion: 复购率是多少？（下单 2 次及以上的用户占全部下单用户的比例）
targets.originalGoldSql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM per_user;
